name: health
title: Dashboard health
description: Is the dashboard up: version, projects, watcher state, runs running and queued.

name: portfolio_overview
title: Argus overview
description: One card per project: threads, open questions, tests, runs. Start here to learn the project keys.

name: board_summary
title: Board summary
description: A project board in one call: threads with notes, items with AC progress, open questions, pending decisions, tests, locks, runs running and queued, the handed build.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: list_threads
title: List threads
description: The threads of a project board (hidden ones, archived or paused, only with includeHidden).

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: list_items
title: List items
description: Work items of a project, in short form (id, status, thread, subject, title, AC done/total). Use get_item for one in full.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: get_item
title: Get an item
description: One item in full with its tests, entries (questions, decisions) and manual actions.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: list_tests
title: List tests
description: Tests of a project in short form. status is pending (not run), pass, fail, partial, blocked or moved.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: get_test
title: Get a test
description: One test in full: steps, what proves pass and fail, results, and proof images as absolute urls.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: list_agents
title: List agents
description: Sub-agents registered on the board, each with the dashboard runs it started.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: list_entries
title: List entries
description: Questions, decisions, notices and messages on the board (the owner page edits are left out). Each carries its context (what it is about, why it needs the owner) and, for a decision, its options with the recommended one first. open=true keeps those waiting for an answer.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: search
title: Search the boards
description: Text search over items, tests, entries, threads, actions, agents and log lines. Omit project to search every project.

project.description: A project key, or "all". Defaults to the default project, else every project.

name: run_status
title: Run status
description: The launches a lead defined and the runs started from them. With run: that one run. Otherwise the defs plus recent runs (filter by name or status).

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: list_launchers
title: List launchers
description: What the owner can start from the Builds tab (coord launcher set): each launcher, master first, then the current ones, with its command, folder, kind, branch, commit and note, its Play run name (start it with run_start) and the bundles that link it. Every build but the master serves one work item (for: I-n) and closes with it (retiredByItem names the item whose closing retired it); relink: true marks a build still waiting for a link. Retired ones only with includeRetired.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: run_logs
title: Run logs
description: Output of a run. Without after, the last tail lines (default 200). Pass after=<next> from the previous call to follow it.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: post_entry
title: Post an entry as the owner
description: Post to a board as the owner: a follow-up, a decision, an acknowledgement, a done tick for a manual action, or pause/resume of a thread (replyTo = the thread). Applied at once; the result says applied, conflict or refused.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: answer
title: Answer an entry as the owner
description: Answer a question or message on the board. decision=true makes the answer a decision the thread must pick up.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

entry.description: Entry id, e.g. Q-7 or D-2.

name: decision
title: Record a decision as the owner
description: Post a standalone owner decision to the lead of the project, optionally tied to an item or thread.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: record_test_result
title: Record a test result as the owner
description: Record the owner's result on a test: pass, fail, partial or blocked. A note (text) is required for fail, partial and blocked: say what you saw.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: run_start
title: Start a defined run
description: Start a launch a lead defined with `coord run define` (by name only; always hidden). If the definition is already at its parallel limit the live run comes back with already=true.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: run_stop
title: Stop a run
description: Stop a queued or running run (its whole process tree).

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: attach_proof
title: Attach a picture
description: Attach an image (png, jpeg, gif, webp) to a test as proof, or to a run. Give exactly one of path (inside a project root, the coord home or the temp folder) or base64, and exactly one of test or run.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: send_to_lead
title: Send a note to a project lead
description: From the Overlord level: send a note (or a decision) down to the lead of one project, or "all". Delivered at once, or when the project gets a board.

project.description: A project key, or "all".

name: notify_owner
title: Ping the owner
description: Send the owner a notification: an OS toast on his screen and a line in Argus > Notifications (the last 50). Ping only when he is needed: a build ready to test, a decision only he can make, something broken that only he can fix; never for progress or a done with nothing to look at. level ping (default) shows a toast, info only records it, urgent stays on screen until dismissed (only when he must act now). More than 3 toasts a minute from one caller are recorded without a toast. Unlike the tools above it does not act as the owner: it speaks to him.

project.description: Project key (see portfolio_overview). Optional when the server was started with a default project.

name: list_dependencies
title: List dependencies
description: Cross-board dependencies: one row per request from an item of one project to an item of another (id, state, from, to, title, reason). Optional project keeps those that start or end there. Only while dependencies are on.

project.description: Only the dependencies that start or end on this project (see portfolio_overview).

name: cancel_dependency
title: Cancel a dependency
description: Cancel an open or blocked cross-board dependency as the owner. The requester stops waiting and the assignee item is dropped. Only while dependencies are on.
